messages:
Ravi: Heads-up — Solstice wants a final perf validation tomorrow 08:00 PT. Requirements: mixed workload 1000 sustained qps, 30m soak, mix = 45% chat (avg ctx 700 tokens), 55% embeddings (batch-embed). SLO: chat p95 < 180ms, p99 < 450ms. They require customer CMK envelope encryption and audit logs. Need a concise run plan, ops config snippet, and a rough cost delta. Can @Nora take infra and @Han the harness?

Nora: Recommend Dedicated pool in us-west-2 with pinned nodes. For 1000 qps and ctx=700 we should plan for 4	6 GPU-equivalents depending on quant. Enable prefix + kv caching and embed batching at gateway. Use KMS-proxy to avoid per-request HSM unwraps.

Han: Ill own harness. Run phases: smoke (5m @75 qps), ramp (12m to 1000 qps in 6 steps), soak (30m), cooldown (5m). Capture p50/p95/p99 per phase, kv hit rate, embed batch distribution, and span traces. Quick load config: ```json
{"target_qps":1000,"ramp_mins":12,"soak_mins":30,"mix":[{"type":"chat","pct":45,"ctx":700},{"type":"embed","pct":55,"batch_max":24}],"metrics":["p50","p95","p99","kv_hit"]}
```

Izzy: Ops tuning: model_batch_size=14, token_budget_ms=180, kv_cache_ttl=10h, embed_batching=true, embed_pool_workers=8. Fallback: if p95 > 250ms or queue_growth > 200ms, route new embeds to quantized-embed and enable model-variant spill to smaller quant during spike.

Nora: Security note: KMS unwrap adds ~5-12ms median; remote HSM spikes are possible. For the POC we will ask customer to allow our KMS-proxy and provide CMK ARN; need signed addendum. We'll enable audit sampling at 100% for unwrap events.

Ravi: Great. @Han schedule 08:00 PT and tag run solstice-5332100000. @Izzy please drop the ops config JSON by EOD and @Nora DM legal the KMS addendum template. ops-bot: queue the run.

ops-bot: Run queued by Han — id: br-5332100000, start_time: 2026-06-02T15:00:00Z, phases: smoke/ramp/soak/cooldown.

Han: Harness queued and smoke verified. Will post brief results (p50/p95/p99 + one-line ops action list) after soak.
